title: In this town, everyone has a cloud that rains when they're sad
description:
In our town, everyone has a little white cloud over their head, and it rains when they're sad. Mine is the biggest one on the street, and it has never rained. Not once.

Since my aunt moved across the sea, Mum's cloud has gone dark and low, and she sleeps out in the glasshouse among the plants they shared. Then something with a very long neck started looking in through the glass.

It's made up, a creepy blocky story built with code and Blender.
pin: When did your cloud last rain?
